review: independent fresh-context review of the frozen M09 first pass
method: general-purpose agent with no prior context, in its own detached read-only worktree at 4166806; given the audit, the frozen corpus, the ten claimed design decisions and the changed-file list — no author rationale and no instruction to approve. Probes lived outside the repository; ordering by latches/events at named seams, never sleeps; everything under the desktop-isolating runner; benchmarks and native suites not run by the reviewer (a timing run was in progress). Findings labeled EXECUTED or SOURCE_PREDICTION.
reviewer_result: 14 alleged defects (0 critical, 0 high, 6 medium, 8 low incl. one bundle of small items), 12 executed; probe file 1/14 passing (the one pass a control)
author_reproduction: every probe re-run by the author on the working tree (13 reproduced, control passed); each allegation then got the author's own fail-first regression, written against the seam rather than the reviewer's probe, and run against a git-archive export of the frozen tree

allegations.summary: deferred Open Hub lost when the insertion queue goes idle between the coordinator's pending read and its deferred flag; a later insertion then activated the Hub
allegations.repair: e681981: the idle listener always posts the flush, which reads the flag on main

allegations.summary: a request re-admitted after a revocation was spawned after the lock was released and could overtake a newer selection/search; second route: an admission's generation was taken under the lock but submitted outside it, so an admission from another thread could displace a newer pending request
allegations.disposition: reproduced (both routes; the second executed by the author's regression)
allegations.repair: e681981: re-admission inside the critical section that checked generation and target; caec491: admissions submitted under the same lock

allegations.summary: Approve/Reject acted on the first queue row when the selected example had none
allegations.repair: e681981 (selection absent from the queue refuses); caec491 (no selection refuses: no first-row default)

allegations.summary: span offsets typed against R1 survived a same-example re-render showing R2 and were saved against R2
allegations.repair: e681981: editors bound to the example and its displayed stage artifacts; cleared with a note when they change

allegations.summary: Teach diffed the correction against the cleaned text while the displayed final text was an applied transform
allegations.disposition: reproduced; repaired at the M09 seam by refusal (the learning service's notion of final text is M14's). The retry variant (final text changing after render) is a source prediction left as an M14 lead: teach_correction takes no expected artifact identity.
allegations.repair: e681981: Teach refuses a row whose final text is an applied transform
allegations.note: the reviewer's probe still fails on the repaired tree by design: its oracle requires the M14 remedy (diff against the transform output), not a refusal

allegations.summary: Copy/Paste Again substituted the source transcript when the cleaned text had expired (present on the base too)
allegations.repair: e681981: no final stage, no final text; both refuse

allegations.summary: Export Redacted wrote a newer state load not yet on screen
allegations.repair: e681981: exports the window last drawn

allegations.summary: each History source was cut under the limit in captured_at string order before the instant merge; offset and malformed timestamps displaced the newest dated row
allegations.repair: e681981: the SQL cut orders by the merge's instant (explicit Z or +-HH:MM only; parse_instant aligned to the same rule) and tie-break

allegations.summary: after a retention pass dropped a hidden view's detail, the still-selected row never showed its detail again
allegations.repair: e681981: showing History/Models reloads a kept selection's missing detail

allegations.summary: a deleted transcript stayed in the hidden Training detail widget
allegations.disposition: reproduced; the author found the same shape in the Your Voice pane (a profile the deletion invalidated stayed rendered) and fixed both

allegations.summary: a retention purge left the purged recording playing (the retention half of AUDIT-07)
allegations.repair: e681981: revalidate notifies the Hub, which stops audio no longer available

allegations.summary: History Move→Scratchpad calls a misspelled method and raises; nothing reaches the coordinator (present on the base; introduced by d2ef224)
allegations.disposition: confirmed; M12-owned per the task, not repaired under M09

allegations.summary: Delete Everywhere proceeded unconfirmed if the alert could not be created
a timeout in the span save's range pre-read (nothing submitted) was reported as a write that may still complete
allegations.repair: caec491: the service refuses it as not saved

allegations.summary: the job-timeline header named the current filter, not the loaded one
shape checks accepted a trailing newline; model_id accepted dot-only segments
allegations.disposition: reproduced by the author; relative two-segment paths that look like hub ids (e.g. a bare 'Users/name') cannot be told from hub ids by shape and remain accepted
allegations.repair: caec491: whole-value matches; dot-only segments rejected

allegations.summary: revocation is applied when the delete op runs and is not undone if that delete rolls back
allegations.disposition: accepted as designed (fails safe for privacy; documented in contracts/hub.md)

allegations.summary: Record Label with an empty field used the state selection, not the rendered example
store timeouts on mark/pin/exclude were shown as failures although the write may commit
allegations.repair: caec491: shown as an unknown outcome
